reply: For the whey stream, NIR Transmission is suitable due to its ability to handle transparent or semi-transparent liquids, offering higher accuracy for low-concentration components. For the opaque milk concentrate, NIR (diffuse reflection) is recommended as it can handle highly scattering environments. Each method should be tested individually before considering a combination, as the gain from combining them is a hypothesis to test. Use laboratory protein and fat results for calibration and validation.
